title: Mechanism exploration of QingReXiaoZheng Decoction on renoprotection in diabetic kidney disease: Integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking and experimental validation.
authors: Chen, Huixi; Li, Yaotan; Xia, Chenhui; Zhou, Shaofeng; Peng, Hulinyue; Sun, Weiwei; Wang, Yaoxian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对糖尿病肾病的保护机制，分子对接仅用于药物-靶点结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: QingReXiaoZheng Decoction (QRXZD), a modern clinical empirical prescription, has demonstrated significant efficacy in treating diabetic kidney disease (DKD). However, the underlying renal protective effects of QRXZD remains uncertain. AIM OF THE STUDY: To explore the potential therapeutic mechanisms of QRXZD in DKD through network pharmacology and experimental validation. METHODS: Firstly, we employed an integrated approach combining network pharmacology and molecular docking to predict the potential targets and mechanisms of QRXZD in DKD treatment. Subsequently, a DKD rat model was established to evaluate the renoprotective effects of QRXZD. Pathological staining, biochemical assays, Western blotting, immunohistochemistry, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, and immunofluorescence were conducted to elucidate the underlying mechanisms of QRXZD in DKD treatment. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis revealed that QRXZD may exert renoprotective effects by inhibiting the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding affinity between the active ingredients of QRXZD and disease-related targets. In vivo experiments confirmed that QRXZD ameliorated renal pathological damage and delayed disease progression in DKD rats. Mechanistic studies indicated that QRXZD attenuated renal inflammation and oxidative stress while reducing tubular injury in DKD rats by suppressing PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathway activation and restoring Nrf2 expression. CONCLUSION: QRXZD alleviates renal injury, inhibits renal inflammation and oxidative stress, and reduces renal tubular injury in DKD rats by regulating the PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB pathway and restoring Nrf2 expression.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：清热消癥汤（QRXZD）作为一种现代临床经验方，在治疗糖尿病肾病（DKD）方面显示出显著疗效。然而，QRXZD潜在的肾脏保护作用仍不明确。研究目的：通过网络药理学和实验验证，探讨QRXZD在DKD中的潜在治疗机制。方法：首先，我们采用结合网络药理学和分子对接的综合方法，预测QRXZD在DKD治疗中的潜在靶点和机制。随后，建立DKD大鼠模型以评估QRXZD的肾脏保护作用。通过病理染色、生化检测、Western blotting、免疫组织化学、酶联免疫吸附试验和免疫荧光等方法，阐明QRXZD在DKD治疗中的潜在机制。结果：网络药理学分析显示，QRXZD可能通过抑制PI3K/Akt信号通路发挥肾脏保护作用。分子对接表明，QRXZD的活性成分与疾病相关靶点之间具有强结合亲和力。体内实验证实，QRXZD改善了DKD大鼠的肾脏病理损伤并延缓了疾病进展。机制研究表明，QRXZD通过抑制PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路激活和恢复Nrf2表达，减轻了DKD大鼠的肾脏炎症和氧化应激，同时减少了肾小管损伤。结论：QRXZD通过调节PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB通路和恢复Nrf2表达，减轻DKD大鼠的肾损伤，抑制肾脏炎症和氧化应激，并减少肾小管损伤。
